# Karouselmaker

> Karouselmaker is an AI carousel generator for creating publish-ready Instagram and TikTok posts from a reusable project brief.

## What it does

Karouselmaker helps founders, marketers, and small businesses turn a project brief into a polished social carousel. A project keeps the niche, offer, brand context, templates, and generated posts together. Users can paste a public product website or describe an offer manually, choose a topic, then generate an editable title, slide sequence, caption, and hashtags.

Each carousel is designed around a clear hook, useful information, a practical payoff, and a fitting call to action. Users can choose built-in template collections or a single template, edit slide copy and imagery, then download a ZIP with slides in posting order alongside copy ready to paste.

## Supported formats

- Instagram carousel posts
- TikTok Photo Mode / carousel posts
- A title, caption, hashtags, and export-ready slides
- Feed, square, and story-ready placements

## Product boundaries

- Karouselmaker is a focused carousel publishing workspace rather than a general graphic design editor.
- Direct TikTok posting is currently an admin-only test feature; users download post-ready files for normal publishing.
- It does not guarantee reach, sales, followers, or conversions.
- Users review generated copy, images, and claims before publishing.
